items.title: 61539_Butter Jackson oral history interview
items.q: He got me to go to my first teacher I ever went to when I went to Jerry [Chimmer] in Chicago when we was playing in Chicago in 1941.

ctx.x: He got me to go to my first teacher I ever went to when I went to Jerry [Chimmer] in Chicago when we was playing in Chicago in 1941. He got me to go to Jerry [Chimmer.] He also got me to go to Donald [Reinhardt.] Keg did this.
But Keg could play a lot of trombone. He could do anything that he wants to do with the horn and he could play anything that you would put up in front of him.
